name: Port the main menu, pause menu and HUD
body: Replace games/platformer/ui/main-menu.nyx, pause-menu.nyx and hud.nyx with .chaos components and .cosmos sheets. The game keeps its state machine in main.nyx; the UI reads a UI model object's @signal fields and writes the player's choice back to it.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-30. games/platformer/ui: game-screen, main-menu, pause-menu, hud, menu-button (.chaos), GameUiModel with @signal fields, global/menus/hud (.cosmos). Old Ui::: menus deleted.
